# pmon_group_member (Resource)

One principal's membership of one group.

Non-authoritative: it adds and removes exactly this membership and leaves the group's other members alone, which is what makes it safe to use on a group the IdP also populates.

Membership of an `OIDC` group is reconciled from the IdP group claim on login, so managing it here will fight the IdP. Manage `LOCAL` groups here and let the IdP own its own.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Adds exactly this membership and leaves the group's other members alone.
resource "pmon_group_member" "alice" {
  group_name = pmon_group.alpha_service.name
  principal  = "alice@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_name` (String) Group to place the principal in.
- `principal` (String) Principal to add, as pmon knows it, usually an email address.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Composite id: group name, then principal.
terraform import pmon_group_member.alice 'alpha-service,alice@example.com'
```
